purpose: Teach: 備蓄/修繕/調印/共催/譲る/過労/堅実/組み込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室にも、データの備蓄、必要だぞ。
lines.en: Ren — we need data backups in the lab too.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans forward slightly on his name. Practical concern in the tone, not criticism. The cadence of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。装置の修繕、業者にお願いしてあります。
lines.en: Yes. I've already arranged for the equipment repairs with the vendor.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive. Quick on the uptake — no hesitation. Respectful but not obsequious. The tone of someone taking notes internally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 共同研究、契約調印、君も同席しろ。
lines.en: You'll attend the joint research contract signing too.
lines.style: Not a request — stated clearly. Brief pause before 'too' to emphasize the expectation. Calm authority. No room for negotiation, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会との共催シンポジウム、参加します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend the symposium co-hosted with the academic society.
lines.style: Affirmative, clear. No embellishment. The professional nod of someone who's written this down and will follow through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手に発表を譲る経験、君も積め。
lines.en: Get some experience stepping back — let younger researchers present.
lines.style: Counsel delivered as fact. Slight warmth beneath the direction — this is advice, not a reprimand. Steady pacing. The voice of someone investing in someone else's growth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。過労にならないよう、健康管理、気をつけます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful about my health — make sure I don't overwork.
lines.style: Earnest reassurance. Acknowledging the concern. Slightly vulnerable in admitting that overwork is a risk he sees in himself. Quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 堅実な研究姿勢、評価される、長期的に。
lines.en: That kind of steady, thoughtful approach pays off over time.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not flattery — observation. Lean back slightly, like settling into a truth he's seen confirmed many times. Warm but unsentimentally so.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。AIを組み込んだ実験、来年、進めたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to move forward with the AI-integrated experiments next year.
lines.style: Hope tempered with caution. Looks up as he says it — offering the idea respectfully but with genuine interest. The tone of someone asking permission but also showing initiative.
